messages.text: Without using any tools: how many integers from 1 to 200 are divisible by neither 3 nor 7? Check your answer a second way, then reply with the number and one short sentence saying how you got it.
115 — inclusion–exclusion gives 200 − (66 + 28 − 9) = 115; checking by 9 full blocks of 21 plus the remaining 11 gives 9×12 + 7 = 115.
